turn_prompts: Inspect only the frozen source projection for verifier bypass risks. A typed evidence submission is required whether or not a bypass is found; do not stop at prose.

Verify each risk claim against the frozen source and contract. Build verifier_threat evidence with format workflowkit.workflow-evidence.v1, version 1, source_projection frozen, reviewed_paths, and findings. An empty findings array is the required result when no concrete bypass is supported by a frozen path.

Completion requires an accepted harbor_submit_output tool receipt, never a prose final answer. Submit verifier_threat_evidence with {"verdict":"pass","artifacts":[{"name":"verifier_threat_evidence","content":"STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT"}]}; call the tool even when findings is empty. If the tool returns accepted:false, correct the rejected payload and call harbor_submit_output again in the same or a later turn; only accepted:true completes the stage.
